The '''Senex Trace''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It began at [[Karfeddion/Legends|Karfeddion]] in the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]]<ref name="TEA" /> and ended at [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], along the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]]. The [[planet]] [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]] was located along the route, at the junction of the Trace and the [[Ado Spine]].<ref name="SoR" />
